title: AI Brand Visibility & GEO Rank Tracker Input

brandName.title: Target Brand Name
brandName.description: The exact brand, company, or product name you want to monitor (e.g. 'Linear', 'Shopify', 'Stripe').

brandDomain.title: Target Brand Domain
brandDomain.description: Your brand's primary website domain to track direct citation links (e.g. 'linear.app', 'shopify.com').

brandAliases.title: Brand Aliases / Alternative Names
brandAliases.description: Other common names or variations used for your brand.

competitors.title: Competitor Brands to Benchmark
competitors.description: List of competitors to monitor for co-mentions and calculate relative Share of Voice (SOV).

industry.title: Industry / Product Category
industry.description: Industry or software category used to generate automated recommendation prompts (e.g. 'project management', 'CRM', 'accounting').

platforms.title: AI Platforms to Audit
platforms.description: Select which AI search engines to query.

customQueries.title: Custom Search Queries (Prompts)
customQueries.description: Specific search queries or buyer prompts to submit to each AI engine.
prefill: What are the best project management software for engineering startups in 2026?
Top alternatives to Jira for fast agile development

queryTemplates.title: Automated Query Categories
queryTemplates.description: Automatically generates category-specific prompts if custom queries are not provided.

maxQueriesPerPlatform.title: Max Queries per Platform
maxQueriesPerPlatform.description: Maximum number of queries to execute per selected AI platform.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API Key (Optional BYOK)
openaiApiKey.description: Provide your own OpenAI API key to execute queries directly with your account models.

perplexityApiKey.title: Perplexity API Key (Optional BYOK)
perplexityApiKey.description: Provide your own Perplexity API key to query Sonar models with real-time web citations.

geminiApiKey.title: Google Gemini API Key (Optional BYOK)
geminiApiKey.description: Provide your own Google Gemini API key to query Gemini 1.5 with Google Search grounding.

anthropicApiKey.title: Anthropic Claude API Key (Optional BYOK)
anthropicApiKey.description: Provide your own Anthropic API key to query Claude 3.5 models.
